figs.name: 3-1-and-3-2-material-certificate-verification-diagram
figs.alt: 3.1 and 3.2 material certificate verification diagram showing manufacturer and independent inspector
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a 3.1 certificate is signed by the manufacturer inspection representative and a 3.2 adds an independent or buyer inspector.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Who verifies a 3.1 and a 3.2 material certificate under EN 10204</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Who Signs a 3.1 and a 3.2 Certificate</text>
<rect x="40" y="80" width="200" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140.0" y="119.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Manufacturer</text>
<text x="140.0" y="143.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">production batch</text>
<line x1="240" y1="125" x2="290" y2="125" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="292" y="70" width="216" height="110" rx="10" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="107.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Tests on batch</text>
<text x="400.0" y="130.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">chemical analysis,</text>
<text x="400.0" y="153.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">mechanical tests</text>
<line x1="508" y1="125" x2="558" y2="125" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="560" y="70" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="107.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inspection rep</text>
<text x="665.0" y="130.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">independent of</text>
<text x="665.0" y="153.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">production</text>
<line x1="665" y1="180" x2="665" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="560" y="227" width="210" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ecfccb" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="261.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.1 certificate</text>
<text x="665.0" y="285.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">signed</text>
<line x1="665" y1="307" x2="665" y2="352" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="560" y="354" width="210" height="100" rx="10" fill="#d9f99d" stroke="#3f6212" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="386.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.2 certificate</text>
<text x="665.0" y="409.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">all 3.1 data</text>
<text x="665.0" y="432.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">plus verification</text>
<rect x="40" y="354" width="380" height="100" rx="10" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="386.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Independent inspector</text>
<text x="230.0" y="409.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">third party authority or</text>
<text x="230.0" y="432.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">buyer authorised inspector</text>
<line x1="420" y1="404" x2="558" y2="404" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="490" y="394" font-size="17" fill="#a16207" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">verifies</text>
<rect x="40" y="227" width="380" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="261.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Same test data in both:</text>
<text x="230.0" y="284.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">composition, properties, results</text>
<text x="400" y="495" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3.2 costs more and cannot be issued after manufacture</text>
</svg>

figs.name: 3-1-and-3-2-material-certificate-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose a 3.1 or 3.2 material certificate for a purchase order
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing when to specify a 3.1 or 3.2 certificate, how to treat a 3.1 B request, and listing pump parts that need 3.2.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to choose a 3.1 or 3.2 material certificate</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.1 or 3.2: Which to Specify?</text>
<rect x="250" y="58" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="92.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">New purchase order</text>
<line x1="400" y1="114" x2="400" y2="136" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,137.0 565.0,192 400,247.0 235.0,192" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="187.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Third party or buyer</text>
<text x="400" y="208.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">witness required?</text>
<line x1="565" y1="192" x2="600" y2="192" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="582" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="602" y="147" width="180" height="90" rx="10" fill="#d9f99d" stroke="#3f6212" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="692.0" y="174.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Specify 3.2</text>
<text x="692.0" y="197.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">critical, high</text>
<text x="692.0" y="220.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pressure parts</text>
<line x1="400" y1="247" x2="400" y2="275" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="418" y="267" font-size="17" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,275.0 565.0,330 400,385.0 235.0,330" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="325.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Old spec asks</text>
<text x="400" y="346.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">for 3.1 B?</text>
<line x1="235" y1="330" x2="200" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="218" y="318" font-size="17" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="18" y="285" width="180" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ecfccb" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="108.0" y="312.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Accept 3.1</text>
<text x="108.0" y="335.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">current</text>
<text x="108.0" y="358.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equivalent</text>
<line x1="400" y1="385" x2="400" y2="413" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="418" y="405" font-size="17" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="290" y="415" width="220" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ecfccb" stroke="#4d7c0f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="451.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Specify 3.1</text>
<rect x="580" y="300" width="205" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fefce8" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="682.5" y="331.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">For a pump with</text>
<text x="682.5" y="354.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3.2, list which</text>
<text x="682.5" y="377.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">parts need it:</text>
<text x="682.5" y="400.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">casing, impeller, shaft</text>
<line x1="692" y1="237" x2="692" y2="298" stroke="#a16207" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="530" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Always check heat number, chemistry and test values match</text>
</svg>

figs.name: 3-1-and-3-2-material-certificate-en-10204-types-infographic
figs.alt: EN 10204 certificate types chart mapping 1991 types to 2004 types
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog mapping EN 10204 1991 certificate types to the 2004 edition, showing 3.1 B became 3.1 and 3.1 A and 3.1 C became 3.2.
figs.after_h2: What Does 3.1 B Mean on a Material Certificate?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>EN 10204 1991 to 2004 certificate type equivalents</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">EN 10204: 1991 Types to 2004 Types</text>
<rect x="30" y="60" width="740" height="46" rx="10" fill="#4d7c0f"/>
<text x="110" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1991 type</text>
<text x="390" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Validated by</text>
<text x="675" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2004 type</text>
<rect x="30" y="106" width="740" height="52" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="139" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2.1</text>
<text x="390" y="139" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Manufacturer, no test results</text>
<text x="675" y="139" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2.1</text>
<rect x="30" y="158" width="740" height="52" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="191" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2.2</text>
<text x="390" y="191" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Manufacturer, non specific results</text>
<text x="675" y="191" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2.2</text>
<rect x="30" y="210" width="740" height="52" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="243" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2.3</text>
<text x="390" y="243" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Manufacturer, specific inspection</text>
<text x="675" y="243" font-size="19" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Withdrawn</text>
<rect x="30" y="262" width="740" height="52" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="295" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.1 A</text>
<text x="390" y="295" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Inspector in official regulations</text>
<text x="675" y="295" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.2</text>
<rect x="30" y="314" width="740" height="52" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="347" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.1 B</text>
<text x="390" y="347" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Independent inspection department</text>
<text x="675" y="347" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.1</text>
<rect x="30" y="366" width="740" height="52" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="399" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.1 C</text>
<text x="390" y="399" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Inspector appointed by purchaser</text>
<text x="675" y="399" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.2</text>
<rect x="30" y="418" width="740" height="52" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#d9f99d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="110" y="451" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.2</text>
<text x="390" y="451" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Manufacturer and purchaser jointly</text>
<text x="675" y="451" font-size="19" fill="#3f6212" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3.2</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Only 2.1, 2.2, 3.1 and 3.2 remain in EN 10204:2004</text>
</svg>
